Deterministic verifiers inspect the business state the agent leaves behind, with partial credit and held-out probes.

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download readysolve/MartechBench --repo-type dataset --local-dir MartechBench

2. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/readysolve/MartechBench --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor, Verifiers. Needs: Commercial licence; task data is not public.
